page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-standard-192 is a virtual machine instance belonging to the c4n server family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and features 192 dedicated virtual CPUs. The system is equipped with 720.0 GB of system memory, which yields a resource density of 3.75 GB of RAM per core.

This instance type does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Additionally, it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its high core count and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio, the c4n-standard-192 offers high resource density for large-scale parallel processing. It is designed for workloads that require substantial compute capacity without the need for specialized GPU acceleration or local NVMe drives. Suitable workloads include large-scale web serving, enterprise application hosting, continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines, and distributed data processing.
